name: WebFetch
description: Fetch content from a URL and return it as markdown. HTML responses are converted to markdown; other text responses pass through. Responses larger than 1 MB are truncated. Binary content types (PDF, images, archives, octet-stream) are rejected. Follows up to 5 redirects. 30-second timeout. Read-only — does not modify files.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from. Must be a fully-formed http or https URL.

prompt.description: What to extract or describe from the fetched content. The caller uses this to summarize the response; this tool returns the raw markdown and leaves summarization to the caller.
